name: Enable Right Click & Copy — Smart Unlock + OCR
advertisedUtility: Restore selection, copying, context menus and local OCR.
legitimatePotential: Accessibility, research extraction and local image-to-text can be useful when implemented with per-site, user-triggered access.
cleanRoomRoute: Use activeTab, local OCR, no remote code and a public reproducible build.

name: RapidLens – Google Lens for Screen Search & Images
advertisedUtility: Visual search, product recognition and translation from a selected image.
legitimatePotential: User-triggered visual search can support accessibility, translation and source discovery.
cleanRoomRoute: Capture only an explicit selection, disclose the destination service and request optional host access.

name: QuickLens – Search Screen with Google Lens
advertisedUtility: Search an explicitly selected screen region or image.
legitimatePotential: A narrow visual-search shortcut can reduce friction without continuous page access.
cleanRoomRoute: Use one-shot user gestures, visible previews and no background collection.

name: Password Protect PDF
advertisedUtility: Encrypt PDFs locally with a user-provided password.
legitimatePotential: Offline document protection is useful if the cryptography, file handling and key lifecycle are independently verified.
cleanRoomRoute: Prefer a reviewed local library, published test vectors, no file upload and explicit key-erasure behavior.

name: Allow Copy – Select & Enable Right Click
advertisedUtility: Restore selection, copying and context menus on chosen pages.
legitimatePotential: A user-controlled accessibility tool can be valuable on pages that unnecessarily block standard input actions.
cleanRoomRoute: Limit execution to the active tab and make every override visible and reversible.

name: PixelCheck
advertisedUtility: Inspect marketing pixels and their event parameters on the current page.
legitimatePotential: Consent, analytics and conversion QA benefit from a transparent local event inspector.
cleanRoomRoute: Expose only current-tab events, redact identifiers by default and never transmit captured payloads.

name: Creative Library – Ad Spy Tool
advertisedUtility: Save, organize and compare public advertisements.
legitimatePotential: Public-ad research can support creative analysis, transparency and campaign archiving.
cleanRoomRoute: Use documented public ad-library endpoints and store only user-selected public records.

name: Website Traffic Checker: MirrorSphere SEO Stats
advertisedUtility: Show traffic estimates, keywords, rankings and source summaries.
legitimatePotential: A clearly sourced estimate can help small publishers understand public web visibility.
cleanRoomRoute: Bind every metric to a named API, uncertainty statement and current-domain-only access.

name: Site Signal – Website Traffic & SEO Checker
advertisedUtility: Summarize public SEO and traffic signals for the current site.
legitimatePotential: A minimal current-site audit can make basic web diagnostics more accessible.
cleanRoomRoute: Use explicit current-tab activation, public APIs and no browsing-history collection.

name: SEO Pulse Pro – Website Traffic & SEO Analyzer
advertisedUtility: Analyze public SEO indicators and estimated traffic.
legitimatePotential: Reproducible on-page diagnostics can help site owners find technical publishing problems.
cleanRoomRoute: Separate local page checks from third-party estimates and disclose every outbound request.

name: Private Crypto News Reader
advertisedUtility: Aggregate public crypto news feeds with local search and favorites.
legitimatePotential: A feed reader can reduce tracking and centralize public information without wallet access.
cleanRoomRoute: Use transparent RSS sources, no page injection and no wallet or exchange permissions.

name: Blockfolio: Address Monitor
advertisedUtility: Recognize public addresses or transaction hashes and open the matching explorer.
legitimatePotential: Read-only multi-chain routing can help users inspect public ledgers without signing anything.
cleanRoomRoute: Treat input as public text, never request wallet access and use a fixed explorer allowlist.

name: Crypto Rates & Fiat Converter
advertisedUtility: Display public market prices and convert between crypto and fiat units.
legitimatePotential: A read-only converter is useful when data sources and timestamps are visible.
cleanRoomRoute: Fetch only from documented price APIs and request no page, cookie or wallet access.

name: Crypto Alerter: Price Alarms & Volatility Warnings
advertisedUtility: Notify users when public price thresholds or volatility conditions are reached.
legitimatePotential: Local threshold alerts can reduce continuous dashboard monitoring.
cleanRoomRoute: Keep watchlists local, use fixed market APIs and make notifications the only privileged feature.

name: DeFi Pulse Tracker
advertisedUtility: Track public DeFi market or protocol indicators.
legitimatePotential: Read-only monitoring can make public protocol data easier to compare.
cleanRoomRoute: Use public APIs, disclose freshness and never connect, approve or sign for a wallet.

name: Crypto Price Badge: Quick Glance
advertisedUtility: Show a small public market-price indicator in the browser toolbar.
legitimatePotential: A glanceable read-only display can be implemented with extremely narrow permissions.
cleanRoomRoute: Require only alarms, storage and a fixed price endpoint; no host-wide page access.

name: Multi-Chain Explorer
advertisedUtility: Route public hashes and addresses to the correct chain explorer.
legitimatePotential: A deterministic read-only explorer chooser can reduce wrong-network confusion.
cleanRoomRoute: Use local format detection and a fixed HTTPS explorer registry with no signing capability.

name: LedgerLook: Wallet Checker
advertisedUtility: Inspect public wallet addresses and balances.
legitimatePotential: Read-only address inspection can help reconcile public transactions without exposing keys.
cleanRoomRoute: Accept addresses only, reject seed phrases and private keys, and never imitate hardware-wallet interfaces.

name: Meta & Facebook Ad Library Spy — Save Ads, Finder, Downloader | FeedX-Ray
advertisedUtility: Search, save and compare public ad-library material.
legitimatePotential: Public-ad archiving can support research, accountability and creative comparison.
cleanRoomRoute: Use documented public sources, record provenance and avoid broad injection into unrelated pages.
